answer: Sable Quota Inheritance: each agent identity is issued a fixed daily action quota under a hidden sable-flagged key, and any new identity must inherit a fraction of its sponsor's quota rather than receiving a fresh allocation. An orchard of clones thus dilutes the sponsor's throughput linearly, while each clone still pays full registration compute and a per-identity lantern challenge whose solution cost exceeds the quota it can ever recover. Marginal clones are strictly negative-EV.
